thesis: 论点：作者意图以 YAML / JSON 进入，经 validate、analyze、compile 收成一份编译 IR；prompt、view、render 只消费这份产物。
scope: Class B: author intent YAML/JSON to validate/analyze/compile; compiled IR consumed by prompt/view/render

anchors.claim: Authoring source is YAML/JSON cinematography intent
CLI verbs include validate, analyze, compile, prompt, view, render blender
validate catches structural and semantic errors; unknown fields fail closed
analyze reports continuity warnings (axis, screen direction, eyeline, 30 deg); they are heuristics, not bans
compile produces the shared compiled guidance IR waist
prompt, view, and render consume the compiled result rather than re-interpreting author operations
